description: Wood moisture content (WH-2021 Ch.4 Eq. 4-1..4-4). Two modes: (1) sample-based MC_od/MC_wb from wet+dry masses; (2) drying outcome — mass + water lost when going from start MC to target MC. Optional Gb (kg/m³) returns MCmax and MCsink. Basis 'od' (oven-dry, industry default) or 'wb' (wet).

basic_density_kg_m3.description: Basic density kg/m³ for MCmax/MCsink (max mode)

start_mass.description: Mass at start of drying (drying mode)

name: moisture_content
